about_the_game:
Uh oh. Winnie-the-Pooh ate all of the honey that Christopher Robin set aside for the annual Honey Festival! It's up to Winnie to set things right and prove that his heart is bigger than his stomach by adventuring into the Hundred Acre Wood to collect enough honey to save the festival!

Winnie will dart, dash, bounce, and swim his way through a variety of colorful, hand-illustrated platforming stages filled with whimsy and wonder. He may discover hidden treasures and helpful items, encounter mighty foes seeking to hoard jars of honey for themselves, and feast on plenty of other tasty treats along the way.

COMING SOON IN 2025!!

THIS GAME IS STILL IN ITS EARLY STAGES OF DEVELOPMENT, SO VARIOUS ELEMENTS MAY POTENTIALLY BE SUBJECTED TO CHANGE LATER ON.
